summary.headline: Venus Visibility in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Venus’s eastern and western visibility in Aries through Scorpio, including weather, armies, rulers, disease, death, and public misfortune; the authorities Hermes and Ahmad Abd al-Jalil are cited.
